note: Full Capture V2 software regression for the guarded R6 product-materialization data runtime. The new wrapper may start only a temporary PostgreSQL Compose service against the existing persistent validation bind mount when no PostgreSQL container is running, rewrites DATABASE_URL only in the child process, forces V1 authority and Production V2 disabled, then removes the temporary project to restore the original absent-container prestate. No DUT I/O and no product materialization is performed by this software-regression action.
